description: Performance Manager's declared dependency contract on the upstream RillML (Rill) repository. RillML is the official name; Rill is the contextual shorthand. Rill is an EXTERNAL runtime owned, built and released by its upstream repository; this repository never compiles, vendors or natively tests Rill. The PM-side contract is the independent 'pm-rill-shadow' v1 protocol (deliberately distinct from Rill Runtime IPC API v1/v2/v3). This contract pins the immutable Rill Stable release tag, its resolved commit, the signed stable release index (Ed25519) and the exact pm-adapter artifact (linux/x86_64/musl) consumed by the packaged performance-manager-rill integration. Three versions are deliberately kept distinct: Rill release bundle version (1.5.1), rill-pm-adapter crate/binary version (0.15.0 Preview) and PM adapter protocol version (pm-rill-shadow v1). A missing/invalid entry keeps the Core capability gate fail-closed.
minimumRillVersionDeprecatedNote: DEPRECATED alias for release bundle version; use minimumReleaseVersion (release bundle) and minimumAdapterVersion (adapter crate/binary). minimumRillVersion must never be compared against rill-pm-adapter --version, which reports 0.15.0.
versionRangeSemantics: runtime must satisfy pm-rill-shadow protocolVersion==1 and every required capability; higher unknown protocol major is NOT assumed compatible; missing runtime, unreachable service, protocol mismatch or capability mismatch is fail-closed. Rill release bundle version (1.5.1) and the adapter crate/binary version (0.15.0) are different concepts and are verified separately. Rill Runtime IPC API and the PM adapter protocol are different contracts.

releaseIndex.canonicalSerialization: compact JSON of the payload object with keys sorted (json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')))
releaseIndex.note: The Ed25519 signature is embedded in the stable-index payload wrapper under the 'signature' key; there is no separate signature asset file. The signature must be verified over the canonical serialization above with the fixed publisher public key.

upstream.verifiedBy: v1.5.1 tag -> commit (cba9b3d2) identity PASS, GitHub Release draft=false/prerelease=false, stable-index.json Ed25519 signature PASS (publisher rillml-examples-2026-001), schemaVersion 3/channel stable, exact pm-adapter/linux/x86_64/musl selection, and actual downloaded SHA + size PASS.
upstream.note: The Rill Stable release bundle is 1.5.1; the rill-pm-adapter crate/binary internal version is 0.15.0 (Preview); the PM adapter protocol is pm-rill-shadow v1. These three are distinct and reported separately. The pinned adapter is advisory-only and never mutates OpenWrt/UCI/sysctl/ethtool state. All mutations remain in PM Core. The x86/64 gate consumes the linux-x86_64-musl artifact; linux-aarch64-musl identity is recorded from the signed index but target runtime qualification remains separate.
